items.q: [INTERVIEWER] George Wetling was a good drummer. [INTERVIEWEE] Yes, there were many, many superior players who were white.

ctx.x: Now, we have -- you know, there is a tremendous amount of -- we have this controversy, whether the blacks were the only people who could play. And I would be very willing to say that's okay with me excepting that Dave Tough was white and was an absolute genius. Jack Teagarden was white. These were two very superior players. of course, Bix. There were many, and Bix, Again, I am And I mean
George Wetling was a good drummer.

Yes, there were many, many superior players who were white. Today you've got some of the finest drummers -- Buddy Rich. What's the chap's name who is married to -- Louis Bellson, people like this, there's so many great -- now I think and here is a very interesting thing -- I want to make sure not to get off the track here.
